slot_scores.name: protein_purchase_quantity_type
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the protein options (chicken, salmon, tofu), can you purchase any fractional amount of weight (for example, 150g of chicken), or must these also be bought in discrete units like the vegetables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether proteins can be bought in fractional/continuous amounts or discrete units, directly covering the hidden purchase-unit ambiguity.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the requirement to select at least three different types of vegetables mean that you must purchase at least one pack of each of those three types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the distinct-vegetable-type requirement, but only after the user volunteered it in response to a broad minimum-requirement question; the agent did not directly ask whether a minimum number of vegetable types was required.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent reached READY_TO_MODEL with H2 only partially covered; the minimum-three-vegetable-types requirement was not directly elicited by the agent's questions and was instead volunteered by the user, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

summary: The agent directly resolved the protein purchase-unit ambiguity and confirmed the budget and weight ceilings, but it did not proactively ask about the minimum number of distinct vegetable types; that P1 constraint was volunteered by the user and only clarified afterward.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
